adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — San Guillermo: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Alfonso Castaneda: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive / Panicle initiation. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in Alfonso Castaneda. Rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Alfonso Castaneda
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk; high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive / Panicle initiation.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - Alfonso Castaneda: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: rainfall increases runoff, wash-off, grain wetting, or harvest loss risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Reproductive / Panicle initiation. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Alfonso Castaneda: 11 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.

DISEASE WATCH - Alfonso Castaneda
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.

adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.
Apply split fertilizer doses when field conditions improve.
Keep fertilizer stocks dry and elevated.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Alfonso Castaneda: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Alfonso Castaneda
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.

🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Alfonso Castaneda:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.

ACAP calendar anchor: Sep 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Reproductive. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
